title: Grouping by a one-side column shows a BLANK group with the orphans' amount

source.quote: The values obtained for the group-by columns include the blank values of invalid relationships
source.supports: the group-by values include the blank row

source.quote: all the different values of Sales[ProductKey] with no corresponding row in Product are linked to the single blank row
source.supports: all orphaned rows are linked to the blank row

derivation: Red is Bike (1) and Bell (3): Sales row 1 = 100 (Bell has no sales). Blue is Lock (2): row 2 = 30. Rows 3 and 4 (ProductKey 9) belong to the blank row: 50 + 20 = 70. 100 + 30 + 70 = 200, the total.
